narrative: Sixth round on L9 (the final level of bp35), a fresh-session continuation of rounds 13-17. No win, but substantial NEW findings that REFRAME the level and resolve several round-17 open questions. (1) CONTROL RESOLVED: LEFT from the fall-through landing is SAFE without opening any door (the player slides along the floor band to the left wall at col15, all NOT_FINISHED across multiple slides). Round 17's door-then-LEFT death is therefore CAUSED by the door-opening, not by leftward movement itself. (2) EVEN THE LEFTMOST DOOR ALONE causes the LEFT-death: after opening only the leftmost door (click {x:15,y:3}), the player survives the first two LEFT slides (to col27, then col21) but the THIRD LEFT is fatal. (3) DOORS ARE REAL PASSAGES, not 'wall texture' (corrects round 17): opening the leftmost door turns cols13-17 (rows0-7 in the landing frame, and the shaft below it) into an air column; opening all three opens a chamber at cols13-29. (4) The leftmost door sits at cols13-17 -- EXACTLY the goal's columns (the goal diamond is at cols14-16) -- so opening it carves a vertical SHAFT down the goal's own columns; the fatal LEFT is the player sliding into that shaft and FALLING. The GAME_OVER overview shows WHY the fall kills: a pillar with a color-11 'B0B' eye sits at cols14-16 row20, directly blocking the shaft ABOVE the goal, so the player hits the eye and dies before ever reaching the goal below (the goal completes on touch even mid-fall, so a clear shaft would WIN). (5) LOWER-REGION GRAVITY SWITCHES ARE FUNCTIONAL (corrects round 16's 'all switches exhausted'): after the fall-through, clicking a color-8 switch block in the left column (e.g. {x:3,y:27}) flips gravity and is consumed, giving MORE flips than round 16 concluded -- the economical route (skipping round 16's {x:27,y:3} object-click) preserves them. A repeatable goal re-sighting loop was confirmed: breakthrough + LEFT x3 + flip{x:3,y:27} + RIGHT x3 returns to the up-gravity pocket with the goal re-sighted. (6) COLOR-12 TOGGLE BLOCKS EXIST in L9 (new -- never seen in a live camera frame before this round; visible as a full row of them at rows8-12 in the GAME_OVER overview); the L3-L4 gotcha said bp35 has toggle blocks, and this confirms L9 does too. (7) MAJOR REFRAME: full-grid topological analysis across every reachable state shows the player is confined to cols>=13 in EVERY gravity/position state (a solid cols6-12 wall blocks leftward movement at every row 0-40, in the start room, the up-gravity pocket, AND the fall-through room), while the goal sits in an open pocket (cols0-23, rows40-50) BELOW the main floor (rows33-39, solid across cols6-63) whose only vertical opening is a narrow cols0-5 shaft on the FAR side of the cols6-12 wall. So the problem is no longer 'find the goal' (found, sighted repeatedly) but 'reach the goal pocket past the cols6-12 wall' -- and the leftmost-door shaft is the identified intended descent down the goal's own columns, currently blocked by the row20 pillar eye. No new level banked; frontier stays at level 8.
novel_mechanics_found: The leftmost E-tile door (cols13-17) opens a genuine vertical SHAFT down the goal's own columns (cols14-16), not 'wall texture' as round 17 concluded; sliding LEFT into it makes the player fall.

The door-shaft fall is blocked by a pillar with a color-11 'B0B' eye at cols14-16 row20 (visible in the GAME_OVER overview), ABOVE the goal -- this is why the fall kills instead of touching the goal below and winning.

Color-12 TOGGLE BLOCKS exist in L9 (a full row at rows8-12 in the GAME_OVER overview), never seen in a live camera frame in rounds 13-17; candidate mechanism for creating a safe landing / shield in the door shaft.

The lower-region color-8 gravity switches (left column) are FUNCTIONAL and consumable independently of the two start-room switches, so the economical route preserves extra gravity flips (corrects round 16's 'all switches exhausted').

The player is confined to cols>=13 in EVERY reachable state (start room, up-gravity pocket, fall-through room) by a solid cols6-12 wall spanning rows 0-40; the goal pocket is only openable via a cols0-5 shaft on the far side of that wall.
dead_ends: Growing pillars and sliding across the fall-through room (round 17's corridor) and simple LEFT/RIGHT slides in any gravity keep the player on the cols>=13 side of the wall -- they never reach the goal pocket.
Naive LEFT into the opened leftmost-door shaft is fatal (pillar eye at cols14-16 row20); do not repeat the door-then-slide-into-shaft sequence without first neutralizing or bypassing that eye.
Flip-up via the lower switch + moving only returns the player to the up-gravity pocket (goal visible but unreached); repeated gravity cycling does not descend to the goal.
next_lead: The leftmost-door shaft (cols13-17 = the goal's columns) is the identified intended descent; the blocker is the pillar eye at cols14-16 row20. Next round: neutralize or bypass that eye -- test whether growing the shaft pillar (round-15 click-to-grow) changes the eye's lethality, whether solidifying a color-12 toggle block above the goal creates a safe landing, or whether falling down col13 or col17 (the shaft's frame, off the eye) reaches a walkable ledge from which the player can step onto the goal. Also worth a live scan: whether any of the newly-confirmed color-12 toggle blocks are clickable/reachable from the fall-through room.
